Container.Name: HyPanel
Container.Overview: Hytale server management with isolated Docker game containers, console, file editor, mods, backups, schedules and users. First setup key: docker exec HyPanel cat /data/setup.key . Game containers publish their own UDP ports. Docker socket access gives the panel Docker administrator privileges; expose the panel only through authenticated access and HTTPS. The Host Data Path must exactly match the Appdata mapping.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Panel HTTP port; forward HTTPS from your existing reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent panel database, server files and backups. Must match Host Data Path.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Required to manage isolated game containers.

Config.Name: Host Data Path
Config.Description: Exact host path of the Appdata mapping, for sibling game containers.

Config.Name: Runner Image
Config.Description: Use the same release as the panel image.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Exact browser origin, e.g. https://hytale.example.com; blank for LAN HTTP.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Set true behind an HTTPS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy
Config.Description: Reverse proxy IP or CIDR. Do not use * on an exposed LAN.

Config.Name: Upload Limit GiB
Config.Description: Maximum size of one file upload.
